scenes.heading: EXT./INT. SMALL RAILWAY STATION — NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Reunite a returning traveler with a station promise through a failed signal and the last train.
scenes.conflict: The last train cannot stop while the station signal is dead.
scenes.turn: Repairing the signal reveals An returned because of a promise, not simply to catch a train.
scenes.character_objective: An must restore the signal and reach the train; Linh must decide whether to help him fulfill the unfinished promise.

beats.action: Rainy station setup; An arrives while Linh closes the desk.
An asks about the last train; the lights and signal fail; Linh states the problem.
An frees the service panel, tears his sleeve and cuts his left forearm.
Linh bandages An and asks why he returned.
An answers that he returned for a promise as the signal turns green.
The train arrives; An boards while Linh keeps the red paper crane.

dialogue.master_text: Only if we bring the signal back.
You came back for this station?
